parsed.rationale: Both `PlayerState.isActive` (line 72) and `PlaybackState.isActive` (line 96) are computed properties in the same `Playback` package with a Jaccard similarity of 0.71, indicating near-identical implementation bodies. Since both types live in `Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/` and share no restraint markers (all context flags false), the duplication is unintentional. The idiomatic Swift resolution is to introduce a protocol (e.g., `ActiveStateProviding`) with a default `isActive` implementation in a protocol extension, allowing both `PlayerState` and `PlaybackState` to conform and delete their individual implementations. This keeps the logic in one place within the existing `PlaybackCore` module without requiring a new package dependency.
